newsitem.title: USA: Couple weds in Alabama amid Danny's howling winds.
newsitem.headline: Couple weds in Alabama amid Danny's howling winds.

text.p: Torrential rains and 80 mph winds failed to deter the wedding of an Alabama couple who pressed on with their ceremony Saturday as a hurricane raged outside.

Natalie Nix and Jeff Britt, both of Birmingham, were wed by candlelight in a ballroom of the Grand Hotel Resort on the eastern shore of Mobile Bay, about 20 miles from where the eye of Hurricane Danny came to a stop before dawn.

Hurricane winds strafed the plush 550-acre antebellum complex, downing between 50 and 100 oak trees. The 308-room hotel switched to emergency power when municipal power lines snapped. But the storm's arrival stiffened the resolve of the wedding party and the resort staff.

"Spirits are high. The florist made it through with the flowers and the caterer made it through with the cake," said Suzanne Barnett, a cousin of the 30-year-old bride. "Danny's definitely not invited and we would like for him to go away."
A hotel clerk said the ceremony went off without a hitch, save for a number of guests scared off by the storm's approach.
The bride and groom planned to return quickly to Birmingham and fly off to Hawaii for their honeymoon.
